from pathlib import Path

inp = Path('/inputs/report.html')
out = Path('/work/report.html')

b = inp.read_bytes()
lb = b.lower()
needle = b'</head>'
pos = lb.rfind(needle)
if pos == -1:
    raise SystemExit('No closing </head> tag found')

insertion = (
    b'<meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview)">\n'
    b'<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n'
)

new_b = b[:pos] + insertion + b[pos:]
out.write_bytes(new_b)

# Checks
out_b = out.read_bytes()

# Ensure unchanged outside insertion
if out_b[:pos] != b[:pos] or out_b[pos+len(insertion):] != b[pos:]:
    raise SystemExit('Content outside insertion changed')

text = out_b.decode('utf-8')

# Basic verification
if text.count('name="description"') != 1:
    raise SystemExit('description meta count mismatch')
if text.count('name="robots"') != 1:
    raise SystemExit('robots meta count mismatch')

# Verify placement immediately before closing head
close_idx = text.lower().rfind('</head>')
ins_text = '<meta name="description" content="AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview)">\n<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">\n'
if text[close_idx-len(ins_text):close_idx] != ins_text:
    raise SystemExit('Insertion not immediately before </head> as expected')

print('Wrote', out)
print('Input bytes:', len(b), 'Output bytes:', len(out_b))
print('Inserted at byte offset:', pos)
print('Snippet before </head>:')
start = max(0, close_idx-220)
print(text[start:close_idx+len('</head>')])
